description: <h2><strong>About Sony Music Entertainment</strong></h2> <p>At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.</p> <p>Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we're committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.</p> <p>Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.</p> <p>Sony Music's Product, Design, Engineering & Global Operations (PDEGO) team is seeking a <strong>Lead Software Engineer</strong> to join our engineering team in our London office. title: Senior Engineer, iOS - Instant Rips
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <div>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>Fanatics Collectibles is the home of sports cards, trading cards, and collectibles for over 100 million fans worldwide. As part of the global Fanatics platform, we're rebuilding how collectors discover, buy, sell, and experience their hobby — live, in real time, at scale.</p> <p>Our flagship mobile product, <strong>Fanatics Live</strong>, is where that experience comes to life: live card breaks, real-time auctions, high-traffic chat, marketplace transactions, and deep collection management tools. The stakes are high and the traffic is real — we build for peak-load moments where latency is visible and reliability is nonnegotiable.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>You'll join the <strong>Instant Rips</strong> iOS team — the group responsible for the live-break commerce experience on Fanatics Live. We build the surfaces millions of collectors use in real time: bidding in live auctions, joining breaks, navigating a high-velocity chat stream, and transacting in the marketplace.</p> <p>The iOS stack is modern by design. We're SwiftUI-first, run The Composable Architecture TCA) across the app, use Swift Concurrency throughout, talk to our backend via Apollo GraphQL, and maintain a clean modular SPM codebase generated with Tuist. There's no legacy UIKit app hiding under the surface — you'll be working in a codebase you can be proud of.</p> <p>AI tooling is part of how we work. We expect engineers to use it on the job, give it good context, and verify the output — not just accept it.</p> <h4>What you'll do</h4> <ul> <li>Design and ship production iOS features across the live-break experience: auctions, stream viewing, chat, marketplace, and collector tools</li> <li>Own features end-to-end — API contracts, TCA reducers, SwiftUI views, testing, and release</li> <li>Write genuine test coverage: unit tests with mock dependencies, TCA</li> <li>TestStore assertions, async test patterns — not coverage theater</li> <li>Review pull requests with judgment: surface real defects, prioritize what matters, coach on what to let go</li> <li>Contribute to architectural decisions: modularization strategy, effect management, failure handling</li> <li>Mentor engineers earlier in their career and raise the quality bar across the team</li> </ul> <h4>What we're looking for</h4> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years</strong> building consumer-facing iOS applications at scale</li> <li>Hands-on with AI-assisted development tooling LLM optimization loops, Xcode CLI integration)</li> <li><strong>Swift Concurrency</strong> — async/await, structured concurrency, Sendable, Swift Macros</li> <li><strong>SwiftUI</strong> — stateless/stateful view patterns, NavigationStack, performanceaware composition</li> <li><strong>The Composable Architecture TCA</strong> — Reducer/Store/Action/State, effect management, parent-child delegation, testing with TestStore</li> <li><strong>Apollo GraphQL (iOS)</strong> — schema-driven development, Swift codegen, subscriptions</li> <li><strong>SPM multi-package architecture</strong> — modular feature separation, local packages, clean dependency graphs</li> <li><strong>Tuist or XcodeGen</strong> — project generation tooling; no committed <sub>.xcodeproj </sub><strong>CI/CD</strong> — Bitrise, Fastlane, or equivalent automated build/test pipelines <strong>Static analysis</strong> — SwiftLint, Periphery or equivalent code quality gates</li> <li><strong>Structured commit/PR discipline</strong> tied to a project tracker Linear, Jira, or equivalent)</li> </ul> <h4>Bonus points</h4> <ul> <li>Experience with livestreaming, real-time auctions, or high-throughput WebSocket/subscription workloads</li> <li>Exposure to marketplace or e-commerce iOS applications</li> <li>Passion for sports cards, collectibles, or live commerce</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><em>The above list of job duties is not exclusive or exhaustive and the post holder will be required to undertake such tasks as may reasonably be expected within the scope and grading of the post.</em><br><br><em>Subject to applicable laws, Fanatics Collectibles may choose to run a background check.</em></p> <p> </p> <p><em>Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don’t fall victim to fraud.  Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including ----- For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at <a href="http://www.fanaticsinc.com/careers">www.fanaticsinc.com/careers</a></em></p><div class="content-conclusion"> <p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. title: Financial Crimes Framework & Innovations Manager
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We’re looking for a Financial Crime Framework & Innovation Manager to lead our KYC Framework & Controls team in Pleo’s first line of defence. The team owns our financial crime framework across the UK and EU/EEA, covering KYC, AML/CFT and sanctions screening. You’ll lead a team of specialists while staying hands-on, owning change end to end across multiple entities and jurisdictions. Compliance is a given; the bigger opportunity is using AI and technology to cut manual effort and sharpen our controls. We welcome all backgrounds, so apply even if you don’t tick every box. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our DK/EEA MLRO and lead a remote team of five financial crime specialists. You’ll partner with Operations, who run our KYC processes, plus Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance and our separate transaction monitoring team. What you’ll be doing As a Financial Crime Framework & Innovation Manager, you will: Own and evolve Pleo’s financial crime framework for KYC, AML/CFT and sanctions screening across the UK and EU/EEA Lead and support a remote team of specialists, building trust and a real sense of team Drive change end to end, from spotting the gap to embedding the fix with Operations Use automation and AI to reduce manual effort and improve decision quality Lead our move to a new screening vendor through to go-live Shape our readiness for the EU AML Regulation Manage regulatory audits and inspections, and help set the team’s annual strategy On the roadmap: the screening vendor migration (go-live planned for Q1) and the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027. We’re also finalising a new financial crime operating model, so some responsibilities may shift. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: Significant experience designing and improving financial crime frameworks, controls and operating models in the UK or EU Experience across multiple entities and jurisdictions, covering UK and EU/EEA requirements Experience managing specialists while staying hands-on A track record of leading change end to end, from stakeholders to delivery Demonstrable experience driving innovation, for example AI-enabled workflows or automated controls The ability to turn complex financial crime concepts into clear, practical guidance It’s a bonus if you have: Led a screening vendor migration or a similar system implementation Hands-on experience preparing for the EU AML Regulation You might come from a fintech or a bank. If you’re from a larger bank, show us where you’ve owned broad scope. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You want broad ownership across KYC, AML and sanctions You get energy from finding efficiencies and putting AI to work on real problems You lead specialists by building trust and giving them room This role is not a good fit for you if: You want a pure people-management role. You’ll be in the detail as well as leading You need fully settled scope. Our operating model is being finalised, and some responsibilities may move You’d rather lead an office-based team. Yours is fully remote, and connection takes deliberate effort How you’ll develop in this role In your first six months at Pleo, you’ll: Take ownership of the screening vendor migration and lead it through go-live Take day-to-day ownership of the EU AML Regulation programme Bring your remote team closer together Beyond that, you’ll lead the AI and efficiency agenda across financial crime, with room to grow your scope as the operating model matures. Show me the benefits! Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we’re supportive of families and help you feel that you don’t have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Hiring manager interview: A conversation with the DK/EEA MLRO about your experience and leadership. 45mins. Pleo Challenge: Walk us through the efficiency opportunities you see in one of our processes. 1 hour. Peer interview: 1 hour Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! We are receiving a really high volume of applicants but can only select so many for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background! Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role As a Product Manager - Integration, you’ll bring hands-on accounting expertise into a product environment to shape integrations that match real finance workflows. You’ll sit in our Accounting Integrations team and help ensure spend data (expenses, receipts, VAT, categories) flows cleanly from Pleo into the accounting systems and ERPs finance teams rely on, with minimal manual work. This is a hybrid role at the intersection of accounting domain knowledge, product thinking and technical partner collaboration, where your judgement will directly influence what we build and how it lands for customers. You’ll own a portfolio of integrations and partners, turning customer needs and operational edge cases into clear requirements and improvements delivered with internal teams and external developers. Success in this role shows up in higher export success rates, fewer configuration-related issues and integrations that finance teams can trust at month-end. Who you'll be working with and reporting to You’ll be part of the Accounting Integrations team, focused on connecting Pleo with the accounting systems and ERPs most used by European finance teams. You will report to our Group Product Manager from Integrations and will work closely with Product and Engineering to define requirements, make sound accounting decisions and support delivery across many different systems and data models. You’ll also collaborate with external development partners and ERP vendors building on Pleo’s APIs, acting as a key point of contact to keep implementations on track and aligned with customer workflows. What you'll be doing As an Product Manager you will: Own a portfolio of accounting integrations and partner relationships, balancing customer needs, partner requests and internal priorities. Translate export, reconciliation and month-end close workflows into clear product requirements and integration behaviours. Partner with engineers to define data mapping and implementation details across multiple accounting systems, data models and APIs. Improve the integration set-up and configuration experience so customers can onboard successfully with fewer issues. Act as a trusted accounting domain expert, making pragmatic decisions that improve data quality and reduce manual work for finance teams. Support external partners and ERP vendors building on Pleo’s APIs, ensuring alignment on expectations, delivery and quality. Track and improve outcomes such as export success rate, adoption/activation and integration-related support volume. What you bring Must have Practical bookkeeping and finance process knowledge (expense coding, reconciliation and month-end close). Strong understanding of how accountants, bookkeepers and finance leads work day to day. A solid track record working with product teams from defining requirements through to delivery. Experience managing external partners or senior stakeholders and delivering through influence. Hands-on exposure to technology in a finance context (for example configuring accounting/ERP tools, working with integrations/data imports, or collaborating closely with technical teams). Nice to have Experience with European accounting and ERP systems, and/or an accounting qualification. Partner negotiation experience and/or additional European languages. Working knowledge of APIs, data mapping or implementation projects. Why this role is a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You enjoy bringing real accounting expertise into product decisions and can explain complex finance concepts in a clear, practical way. You like owning problems end to end - from identifying the right solution to working with others to ship it. You’re motivated by improving workflows for finance teams and can connect day-to-day pain points to measurable outcomes. This role is not a good fit for you if: You want a role where you control delivery directly, rather than delivering through internal teams and external partners. You prefer depth in a single system over context switching across many tools, markets and accounting practices. You’re looking for a purely accounting or purely technical role, without the “bridge” work in between. How you'll develop in this role Within your first 6 months, you’ll build a deep understanding of customer export and reconciliation needs and how Pleo’s integrations behave in practice, then take ownership of a defined portfolio of integrations and partners. You’ll identify the highest-impact improvements to the integration set-up experience and drive them to delivery with internal teams. Within 12 months, you’ll be a go-to expert for integration and accounting decisions, with measurable improvements in export success rates and a reduction in configuration-related issues. You’ll help launch new or improved integrations by enabling internal teams and partners with the context and clarity they need to deliver well. Over time, you’ll strengthen your product toolkit (requirements, trade-offs, delivery rituals) and build deeper technical fluency by working side-by-side with engineers on real integration complexity. Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work . We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations. Please note: Applications for this role will close on Wednesday, October 13th to ensure our team has enough time to give every candidate's application the care and attention it deserves. Show me the benefits! Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards). For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro Call (30 min): A conversation with a Talent Acquisition Partner to provide a high-level overview of Pleo and the role, confirm essential skills, and gauge initial alignment. Hiring Manager Interview (45 min): A discussion with your future manager to evaluate your functional expertise, past experience, and role fit. Pleo Challenge (60 min): A role-specific "live session" based on a scenario or business dilemma completed with key stakeholders. Transparency is important to us Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we're looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! CV writing and content: AI can be useful for structure, but generic AI-written CVs often hide your real impact. We’re more likely to engage when you share specific outcomes (for example: “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z”) and explain the context around your decisions. Application care: Our talent team reads every application. Taking a few minutes to tailor your answers and highlight the most relevant examples will genuinely help you stand out. Profile to role fit: This role is best suited to someone who can combine practical accounting knowledge with product thinking and proactive ownership. We’ll be looking for evidence that you understand finance workflows like reconciliation and month-end close, can translate those needs into clear requirements, and are comfortable collaborating with technical teams and external partners to deliver high-quality integrations. title: Legal Counsel
description: At Hive, we're building the defining physical AI platform of the next decade. Industrial labor is one of the most acute bottlenecks in the global economy. Operators are expensive, hard to retain, and working in environments that are increasingly unsafe. The shortage is structural. The window to solve it is now. Our answer is a machine-agnostic intelligence platform that lets any machine, on any site, perceive, decide, and act autonomously. One platform. Any machine. No fleet replacement. Already live across multiple sites and customers in Europe - spanning logistics and warehousing, industrial manufacturing, and large-scale chemical production - with a US expansion underway. The vision: one operator managing hundreds of machines simultaneously. Productive machine-hour cost dropping by 80x, and unlocks the next productivity revolution in physical work. The mission is to make productivity limitless. Come and help us build it. About the Role Hive is looking for a pragmatic, hands-on Legal Counsel to be in charge of all legal matters across the company. This is an in-house operator role, not a policy or pure-oversight seat — you'll draft and negotiate directly, make judgment calls quickly, and know when to bring in outside counsel versus handle something yourself, while remaining ultimately accountable for every legal matter that touches the business. You'll cover everything from entity structuring and fundraising docs to IP strategy, cross-border contracts, and HR-related legal matters, using outside counsel to fill in jurisdiction-specific or specialist expertise rather than trying to be an expert in every market. We need someone who wants to move at startup speed and get things done, not just flag risk. What You'll Own Corporate & Fundraising Manage entity structure and governance across all jurisdictions we operate in (formations, cap table hygiene, board resolutions, filings) Own fundraising legal work — term sheets, SAFEs/convertibles, share purchase agreements, disclosure schedules, and coordinating diligence Manage relationships with outside counsel and investors' legal teams; keep deals moving efficiently Maintain corporate records and ensure ongoing compliance obligations are met Commercial Contracts Draft, review, and negotiate MSAs, DPAs, vendor agreements, and customer contracts, including cross-border deals with varying legal regimes Build and maintain template contracts and playbooks so the business can self-serve on lower-risk agreements Be the primary point of contact for commercial negotiations, balancing legal protection with deal velocity IP Strategy Own IP strategy and protection — trademarks, patents (where relevant), trade secrets, and open-source/licensing considerations — engaging specialist outside counsel for filings and deep technical IP work while retaining overall accountability Ensure IP assignment is airtight across employees, contractors, and any external development partners Advise product and engineering on IP risk as new features and products are built HR & Employment Legal Advise on employment law matters across jurisdictions — contracts, terminations, disputes, disciplinary processes — partnering closely with the People function Review and update employment policies, handbooks, and offer templates as we expand into new markets Manage or support employee relations issues that carry legal risk General Counsel Function Be in charge of all legal matters across the company — the single accountable owner, even where specific work is executed by outside counsel Be the internal point person for any legal question across the company — a true "ask me anything" resource for the team Own the outside counsel budget and relationships pragmatically: handle day-to-day drafting and negotiation directly, and route jurisdiction-specific or highly specialized work (e.g. patent filings, employment law in markets you don't cover deeply, contentious disputes) to the right external partner, while staying accountable for the outcome Assess and manage legal risk across the business (data privacy, regulatory, insurance) with a bias toward practical solutions over theoretical risk-avoidance Advise leadership on legal implications of new markets, products, or business models What We're Looking For Qualified lawyer (England & Wales or equivalent) with in-house or relevant private practice experience Has directly run legal workstreams for fundraising rounds (priced or SAFE/convertible) and understands cap table and investor dynamics Comfortable negotiating cross-border commercial contracts and adapting to different legal systems Practical, commercially-minded approach — knows how to get a deal done, not just advising on employment law matters, ideally across more than one jurisdiction Confident managing outside counsel efficiently — knows what to delegate and what to handle directly Comfortable being a Have Experience in-house at an early or growth-stage startup IP or technology law specialization Experience building legal function/processes from scratch Additional jurisdiction qualification (e.g., title: Contractor Development Manager
description: About Plentific Plentific is pioneering real-time property operations for real-world impact. Our platform connects property owners, operators, service providers and residents, and covers more than 1.7 million properties and 5,000+ service providers. We believe property repairs, maintenance and management can and should work better for everyone. That means giving landlords more control, supporting trade professionals and strengthening the communities they serve. The Role Our clients, mainly social housing providers and local authorities, rely on a strong and reliable network of contractors for their repairs and maintenance works. When they need more capacity in a region or a trade, or a contractor for a specific project, we go out and find the right businesses and bring them onto Plentific. We're looking for a Contractor Development Manager to lead that effort. This is a business development role. You'll identify the contractors who fit our ideal contractor profile and make sure they register to the platform, get them verified and onboard them to the platform. We are looking for experience in business development rather than experience in our sector, and you'll have full support getting to know Plentific and the contractor market. What matters most is that you're proactive, persuasive and resilient, and that you enjoy finding the right contractors and seeing them through to their first job. What you'll do Grow our contractor network Find and reach out to contractors who match our ideal contractor profile. Introduce Plentific and our way of working, answer their questions, and explain what joining means for their business. Sign contractors up to Plentific marketplaces wherever there is a need in supply, and guide them through onboarding on the platform. Where a client needs a contractor for a specific project, find suitable businesses, explain the project requirements, discuss pricing and SLAs, and agree whether it's a good fit. Build channels to reach new contractors alongside direct outreach, such as trade associations, local networks, events and referrals. Verify contractors on the platform Review each contractor's submitted information and check their certificates and other documents against our requirements. Contractors can only start taking on jobs once every verification is complete. Chase missing or incorrect information so they get verified and onboarded quickly and reach their first job. Flag anything that doesn't meet our standards, and share ideas for improving how we verify contractors. Manage your contractor pipeline Own your contractor pipeline end to end, from contractors approached through to sign-ups, verification and active contractors, keeping accurate records of every contractor and conversation in our CRM. Track progress at each stage, understand where contractors drop off, and follow up with those who stall before they are live. Target supply where it is needed Use data to identify the regions and trades where we need more supply, and prioritise your outreach accordingly. description: About Us Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to manage repairs, maintenance, compliance, and contractor operations at scale. The PMO Lead owns this function day to day — coaching Programme and Project Managers (PMs) to a consistently high standard, building the portfolio-level reporting that gives leadership real visibility, and acting as the bridge between delivery teams and senior management when a decision or an unblock is needed. This is a hands-on, first-of-its-kind role at Plentific: the PMO Lead will stand up the standards, cadence, and reporting described below largely from scratch, and will be judged on how quickly the portfolio becomes visible, consistent, and genuinely governed as a result. Key responsibilities 1. Coach Programme & Project Managers, and hold the standard Own and continuously improve the standard toolkit every programme uses — charter, RAID log, status report, change log. Coach PMs on using the standards well — raising the general standard of programme management practice, not just chasing form-filling. Own the stage-gate review process: assess whether a programme is genuinely ready to pass each gate, and issue go/no-go sign-off. Set and enforce mandatory reporting — PMs submit standard, current status on a fixed cadence; the PMO follows up where reporting lapses. 2. Build and run portfolio-level reporting and governance Consolidate individual programme status into one current, accurate portfolio view of schedule, spend, risk, and resourcing. Own the portfolio tracker and the cadence of updates that feed it. Track cross-programme risks and dependencies; make sure each has a named owner and a clear escalation threshold. Prepare and present the portfolio report at each Steering Committee review. Track benefits realisation — confirm delivered programmes actually produced the outcome they were funded for. 3. Work with senior management to report and unblock Act as the primary escalation point when a programme risk or dependency needs a decision above the PM’s authority. Bring blockers to the right senior stakeholder quickly, with a clear ask and options — not just a status update. Represent delivery status and risk to senior management accurately and without spin, including when the news is difficult. Chair or co-chair the portfolio review, and prepare materials for Steering Committee meetings. Track follow-through on decisions and unblocks agreed with senior management, so they don’t silently drop. Authority and mandate This role carries a Controlling PMO mandate — meaning the successful candidate has the authority to require compliance, not just recommend it: Authority, via the PMO charter, to require compliance with standards and mandatory reporting across all active programmes. Key relationships Executive Sponsor / Steering Committee — monthly portfolio reporting, escalation, gate decisions. Programme & Project Managers — coaching, mandatory reporting, gate reviews. Senior management / business leaders — status reporting, unblocking, resourcing conversations. Experience standing up a PMO from scratch, or maturing one from a Supportive to a Controlling model. Familiarity with portfolio/PPM reporting tools. title: Solutions Architect
description: About Plane Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together. Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship. Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules. Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work. Humans and agents We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's. Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives. title: Flexible Brand Ambassador, London Stations (Commission Based)
description: 💙 About Bounce... Bounce is building cloud storage for the physical world, starting with the largest global luggage storage network in existence. Bounce’s marketplace connects travelers with 30,000+ small business locations worldwide for hyper-local short term baggage storage. With more locations globally than Burger King, and more locations in New York City than Starbucks, Bounce has served 3M+ users and stored 10M+ bags, and paid over $10M to small business partners. To achieve this, Bounce is a fast-paced and scrappy team. We believe that experimentation fuels innovation, so we move quickly, testing new ideas and adapting in real time. If you’re ready to make an impact in a high-energy, close-knit, and collaborative environment - Bounce is the place where you can move fast, think big, and shape the future of travel. Join us as we make the world a lighter, more accessible place! Bounce has been named the Inc5000’s fastest-growing travel company in the USA in 2024 and is proudly backed by leading Silicon Valley investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, General Catalyst, and Sapphire. (Learn more about Bounce's Series B HERE and also learn about our Japan Expansion HERE ) About the role... Travellers drag their bags around London all day because they don't know there's another option. Bounce is looking for four Scouts/ Brand Ambassadors, two at King's Cross and two at Victoria, to tell them that option exists. Bounce is the world's largest luggage storage network, with hundreds of locations in London and over 1.1 million bags stored in the city alone. Travellers book on their phone, drop their bags at a local shop or hotel, and get on with their day. This is a self-employed, commission-only role. You earn 40% of the storage value of every booking that comes through your code, and you keep it whether or not the customer uses the discount. For example: What an hour could look like (illustrative, not guaranteed): You speak to around 30 travellers 5 of them book (about 1 in 6) The average booking is three bags for the day, which earns you £5.40 5 bookings × £5.40 = £27 for the hour Where you come in… Positioned around King's Cross or Victoria station and talk to travellers who are dragging suitcases around London Wear Bounce branded gear with your own QR code on it: travellers scan it, book a spot and get 10% off Find people with bags, help them get rid of them for the day, and get paid for it Decide when you go out and for how long, with no fixed schedule or minimum commitment Get set up with your own referral code, QR code, payout account and Bounce branded kit Start with a briefing on what to say, which spots work, and what to steer clear of Get commission paid out through our affiliate system, straight to your bank Your profile… You're happy starting conversations with strangers all day You're warm and quick on your feet, and travellers trust you inside five seconds Confident English. title: Screening and Escalations Senior Payment Analyst
description: Trust unlocks our greatest potential. For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution. What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’. What you can expect: ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank. If that excites you, how about joining our 1st line Financial Crime Operations team as a Screening and Escalations Senior Payment Analyst? Reporting into the Senior Manager, FCO Screening & Escalations you will be responsible for the oversight and investigation system-generated payment screening alerts. You’ll act as a subject matter expert for payment screening across our client base. You’ll also have an excellent understanding of financial crime typologies and detection methods and share this knowledge with Analysts within the team. This role is critical in ensuring our compliance with anti-money laundering (AML) regulations and protecting the integrity of our financial systems. You’ll be raising concerns and providing ideas, engaging with clients, and making informed decisions with your sound knowledge of payment services; excellent technical and regulatory knowledge across financial crime and sanctions within the UK and EEA, including reporting requirements, and you’ll have a firm understanding of how to identify and mitigate risks within a business. Your role includes: Analysing and investigating system-generated alerts related to payment screening. You will use existing information or request information from clients and 3rd parties to support discounting of the alert. Analysing transactions to identify suspicious activities and potential money laundering risks Assessing internal and external intelligence to identify financial crime risk and escalate as appropriate. Where relevant you will raise internal Suspicious Activity Reports (iSARs) Ensuring all investigations and processes comply with relevant AML laws and regulations Acting as a first point of escalation for Payment Screening Analysts Managing escalations and senior management conversations in both first and second lines of defence Allocating tasks, assisting in oversight and prioritisation to ensure any deadlines are met Staying up to date on the latest AML trends, emerging typologies and best practices to enhance the effectiveness of our screening systems Maintaining detailed records of investigations and ensuring timely resolution of cases Following ClearBank procedures & standards, raising and escalating relevant reports where required to ensure compliance with relevant AML laws and regulation What you’ll bring: To excel in this role, you’ll also need: Solid and demonstrated experience in AML, financial crime investigations, or a related field Strong knowledge across all forms of sanctions typologies e.g. Trade Sanctions, dual use goods, Personal and Professional enablers, payments involving complex structures Good knowledge of sectors such as money remittance, electronic money, and cryptocurrency firms would be beneficial Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all tasks Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate and negotiate with key/senior stakeholders Familiarity with screening and monitoring software/tools, and proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite. Strong knowledge of money laundering typologies and experience in dealing with sanctions, complex business models, PEPs, red flags and suspicious activity investigation, bribery and corruption cases involving restricted jurisdictions In-depth knowledge of AML regulations and guidelines Strong ethical standards and integrity in handling sensitive information Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team A recognised AML / Sanctions / Fraud qualification is desirable but not essential Regretfully we are not able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes at the current time. What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you? You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank; You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care; You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate; ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply! What we offer in return: We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance. Offices – Work in a way that works for you – whether that’s in the London office, at home, or hybrid. Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus bank holidays. Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most. Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the UK for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period. Socials – Regular social events open to all. Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice. Wellbeing – 24/7 employee assistance programme including mental health support, life assurance and income protection. Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you. Healthy living – Private healthcare and discounted dental cover, with employee perks and discounts. Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave. Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning. And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future. A little bit more about us! But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. title: Senior Financial Reporting Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London/Distrubuted across the UK | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 (depending on experience) ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> |<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4"> Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Finance team</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a highly proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded Financial Reporting Senior Analyst to join our Financial Reporting team, and help us build a world-class finance function.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges coming up, like expanding into the European Union, introducing Monzo Mobile and Habito to our group, climate change reporting, continuing to grow our customer base, expanding our lending business, and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way while helping us optimize our financial reporting processes with the help of technology. You’ll join the Finance team and report to our Financial Reporting Manager.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Supporting the full year end process, from drafting the annual report to working with external auditors until final sign-off. </li> <li>Supporting tight processes with our internal finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process.</li> <li>Understanding the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Working with our engineers and data teams to automate the production elements of the role, allowing you to focus on the parts of the role where your knowledge and skills provide the most value.</li> <li>Understanding our accounting system and making sure we are taking advantage of all its features to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Being responsible for ensuring our financial reporting policies, procedures and controls are up to date, relevant and useful for Monzo and importantly are scalable.</li> <li>Reviewing new products and the impact of new contracts, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.</li> <li>Working with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.</li> <li>Maintaining existing and developing new controls that protect our financial data and our balance sheet substantiation process.</li> <li>Supporting the production of ESG sustainability reporting and disclosures.</li> <li>Preparing monthly management and ad hoc reports, offering meaningful analysis of movements.</li> <li>Resolving miscellaneous inquiries and supporting the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified chartered accountant (ACA or CA) and ideally have audit experience combined with some financial reporting and control experience outside of practice. </li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls.</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors.</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds.</li> <li>You’re comfortable with leveraging data to automate reporting and drive efficiency (SQL skills would be a bonus).</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment.</li> <li>Nice to have:</li> <ul> <li>Experience in a listed company or financial services regulated environment. </li> <li>Strong business partnering/commercial financial acumen. </li> <li>ESG reporting/audit of sustainability information (carbon footprint, CFD/CSRD).</li> </ul> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰£56,000 - £75,000 (depending on experience) ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role is based in our London office and we aim to come in as a team twice a week. We're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) if required.</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Conversation </li> <li>Initial Hiring Manager Interview (30 Minutes) </li> <li>Role Specific Interview (60 Minutes) </li> <li>Behavioural Interview (45 Minutes)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Business Director, Biddable
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>1812 - Business Director, Biddable</strong></p> <p><strong>About WPP 650</strong></p> <p>Join an award-winning team at the heart of UK government, where your work will genuinely shape lives. As part of WPP 650 you’ll be part of a supportive, collaborative environment that values curiosity, kindness, and growth. Together, we use behaviour change principles to design smarter services, influence better decisions, and help millions of people across the country.</p> <p>Named WPP 650, after the 650 UK parliamentary constituencies, the name is a reminder that our work must reflect the full breadth of the country, every community, every audience. title: Senior Backend Engineer(Go), Storage Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <p>As part of Wolt’s Platform department (Core Group), you’ll help improve and automate operations for our storage access platform - our real time database abstraction layer solution designed with scale and resiliency in mind . The product you will build enforces best practices by design, abstracts database infrastructure, and supports Multi-Region architecture through data sharding and replication. You join a team of highly skilled engineers in designing, building and optimizing this platform and ensuring smooth developer onboarding, constant improvement and optimization. </p> <p>As an engineer on the Storage access platform team, you’ll work on platform features such as UI for developer teams, storage abstraction layer, database automation, client SDK and proxy, Change Data Capture pipelines, caching and ephemeral storage, Hot & Cold storage management and more.</p> <h2>Our humble expectations</h2> <p>You’ll be a great fit for this role if you have the following skills and experience:</p> <ul> <li>A strong developer-to-developer mindset, with a genuine enjoyment of building for internal customers and treating other engineers as your primary users.</li> <li>Adaptability and strong motivation for working with distributed systems.</li> <li>A data-driven approach to decision-making and a collaborative mindset, with the ability to navigate disagreements constructively and deliver consistently.</li> <li>Autonomy in dynamic, fast-paced environments with frequent change.</li> <li>A product- and platform-oriented approach to engineering challenges.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.</li> <li>A collaborative spirit and experience contributing to diverse and inclusive work environments.</li> </ul> <h3>Technical proficiencies:</h3> <ul> <li>Expertise in NoSQL databases, particularly Cassandra or DynamoDB.</li> <li>Experience with large-scale distributed systems, emphasizing both velocity and scalability.</li> <li>Familiarity with SRE principles; however, a background in Backend Development is essential.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of Kubernetes, including EKS, as an end user.</li> </ul> <p>You don’t need to tick every box, but if you see yourself in many of these points, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <h2><strong><br></strong>What we offer</h2> <p>At Wolt, we’re committed to building an environment where engineers can make an impact while enjoying meaningful challenges. As a member of the the team you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Working on solutions that support millions of users</li> <li>Solving complex problems in performance, reliability and automation</li> <li>A collaborative and inclusive culture that supports your professional and personal well-being</li> </ul> <p>We also offer flexible work arrangements, competitive compensation, and ongoing learning opportunities to help you thrive.</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Ncz4s_oBczc?si=FzuwoSOLcv5WZVRN" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. title: Staff Data Engineer - GTM
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2>What is the opportunity?</h2> <p>Every go-to-market decision at Intercom, who we target, who owns the account, what we know about them, what we should say next - rests on a foundation of account and contact data. Getting that foundation right is one of the highest-leverage engineering problems in the company: a single account hierarchy fix can re-route territory, pipeline credit and forecast for thousands of accounts at once.</p> <p>This role owns that foundation. You will build and run the systems that decide what an account <em>is</em>, resolving duplicates, stitching subsidiaries into corporate hierarchies, sourcing new accounts and contacts into our CRM, and enriching them with firmographic, technographic and intent signals. Increasingly using LLMs and web research rather than off-the-shelf vendors. Your work is used daily by Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Sales Ops and Finance, and directly shapes how efficiently Intercom grows.</p> <p>You will sit in the Data group and partner extremely closely with GTM Systems, RevOps and the frontline teams. This is a role for an engineer who wants to be <em>in</em> the business, not adjacent to it. Someone who gets energy from a rep saying "this list is exactly right" and from watching a pipeline they built turn into revenue.</p> <h2>What will I be doing?</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Owning account identity.</strong> Building and improving the entity-resolution layer that decides when two records are the same company: domain and firmographic matching, confidence scoring, and the merge/dedupe pipelines that keep Salesforce clean at scale.</li> <li><strong>Modelling account hierarchy.</strong> Designing the organisation spine that links accounts to their parent, top operating parent and ultimate corporate parent.</li> <li><strong>Building account sourcing pipelines.</strong> Turning market definitions into ranked, deduplicated, CRM-ready account lists: sourcing from third-party and internal signals, scoring fit, and pushing accounts into Salesforce with the right owner and the right metadata.</li> <li><strong>Building contact sourcing and enrichment pipelines.</strong> Finding the right people at target accounts, verifying and enriching them, respecting privacy and consent requirements, and delivering them into the tools reps and marketers actually work in.</li> <li><strong>Building LLM-powered enrichment.</strong> Extending our enrichment framework — LLM jobs with web search and crawling tools across multiple providers, to answer questions no vendor sells: what support channels does this company run, are they hiring CS or sales roles, do they ship an AI product, how ready are they for Fin.</li> <li><strong>Making the data usable.</strong> Landing everything in well-modelled, well-tested dbt models in Snowflake orchestrated in Airflow, and syncing it out to Salesforce, Marketo, Clay and the rest of the GTM stack.</li> <li><strong>Owning quality and trust.</strong> Instrumenting your pipelines with tests, alerts and reconciliation so problems surface before a rep finds them, and being the person GTM comes to when a number looks wrong.</li> <li><strong>Partnering on the problem, not the ticket.</strong> Sitting with Sales, Marketing and Ops to understand what they are actually trying to do, then proposing the data foundation that unlocks it.</li> </ul> <h2>What skills do I need?</h2> <ul> <li><strong>A genuine interest in growing the business and a real affinity for GTM teams.</strong> You are curious about how sales and marketing work, comfortable in a room full of reps, and motivated by commercial outcomes rather than only technical ones.</li> <li>Experience with the modern data stack: dbt, a cloud warehouse (we use Snowflake), and a DAG orchestrator (we use Airflow).</li> <li>Experience building with LLMs in production: prompt design and evaluation, tool/function calling, web search and crawling, cost and title: Senior Manager, HR Business Partnering
description: ABOUT THE ROLE The Senior Manager HR Business Partner is a senior strategic HR partner and key advisor to the functional leadership team. You act as the lead HR owner of the people strategy for a global C-Suite leader and their direct leadership team, ensuring that talent strategy supports business performance and growth. In this role, you provide proactive, data-driven insights, using data to anticipate talent trends and design structures that optimize for speed, global scalability, and efficiency. As a confidential "Trusted Advisor," you guide senior stakeholders through complex leadership dynamics, succession planning, and organisational evolution. You balance high-level strategy with the leadership of an HRBP team, ensuring that global people initiatives are executed with precision and functional relevance. Strategic Acumen: Deep expertise in organisational design, workforce planning, and change management. Leadership Experience: A track record of leading and developing HR professionals, with the ability to pivot a team from operational tasks to strategic ownership. Analytical Mindset: Ability to use data to tell a story, predict trends, and influence business investment in people initiatives. Global Mindset: Experience navigating complex legal, cultural, and operational landscapes across multiple regions. WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. title: Clinical Training and Education Lead
description: What is the job? This is an opportunity to shape how our clinical teams learn, develop and perform as Montu continues to grow. Sitting within the Learning and Development function, you will take ownership of the learning experience across our clinical teams. You will build structured, engaging and practical development programmes that give our people the knowledge, skills and confidence to deliver safe, consistent and patient-centred care. You do not need to be a clinician or hold a professional healthcare registration. However, you will need to understand the realities of working in a clinical environment, including the importance of patient safety, clinical governance, regulatory compliance and quality. Working closely with clinical subject-matter experts, operational leaders and the wider People team, you will turn complex standards, processes and clinical requirements into learning that people can understand, apply and embed in their everyday work. This is a hands-on role for someone who is passionate about developing people, confident working with specialist stakeholders and comfortable building learning solutions in a fast-paced and evolving environment. What You Will Own Clinical Learning and Development Own the learning and development plan for our clinical teams, ensuring it supports business priorities, service growth and workforce capability Design and deliver structured onboarding, induction and ongoing development programmes for new and existing team members Build clear learning pathways that support employees from joining the business through to continued development and career progression Create engaging workshops, digital learning, practical resources and supporting materials for a range of clinical audiences Conduct training needs analyses, skills audits and capability assessments to identify current and future development priorities Deliver group workshops, virtual learning sessions and one-to-one coaching where required Support the delivery and monitoring of mandatory training and continuing professional development requirements Competency and Capability Develop clear and practical competency frameworks in partnership with clinical subject-matter experts Create consistent approaches to assessing knowledge, skills and competence across clinical teams Work with managers to identify capability gaps and put appropriate development plans in place Support leaders in embedding coaching, feedback and reflective practice within their teams Ensure learning is transferred into day-to-day performance rather than ending when the training session finishes Clinical Standards and Governance Work closely with Clinical Governance, Quality, Safeguarding and operational leaders to ensure learning reflects current standards and requirements Translate clinical policies, pathways, Standard Operating Procedures and regulatory requirements into clear and practical learning Support the rollout of new clinical services, systems, technologies and ways of working through effective training and change support Ensure relevant learning supports Care Quality Commission standards, patient safety requirements and internal governance expectations Recognise where specialist clinical input or approval is required and work with the appropriate subject-matter expert Maintain accurate learning, competency and compliance records across clinical teams Learning Impact and Continuous Improvement Establish clear measures of success for learning programmes and evaluate their impact on capability, performance and service quality Use assessment outcomes, employee feedback, audit findings, quality data, incidents, complaints and patient feedback to identify learning priorities Produce meaningful learning insights and reports to demonstrate progress, risks and areas for improvement Regularly review and improve learning content to ensure it remains accurate, relevant and effective Identify opportunities to improve how learning is delivered, recorded and embedded across the business Champion a culture where learning, coaching, feedback and continuous improvement are part of everyday work Stakeholder Partnership Build credible and trusted relationships with clinical, operational and People leaders Partner with subject-matter experts to create learning that is clinically accurate, engaging and appropriate for its audience Coach and support managers to identify development needs and build capability within their teams Balance learning priorities with operational requirements in a busy and fast-moving environment Act as the Learning and Development lead for relevant clinical change and transformation projects What do you need? Strong experience within Learning and Development, workforce development, operational training or a similar role A good understanding of clinical or healthcare environments, including patient safety, clinical governance, quality and regulatory requirements Experience designing and delivering engaging learning programmes for specialist, operational or regulated teams Strong learning design skills, with the ability to turn complex or technical information into clear and practical learning Experience developing structured onboarding programmes, learning pathways or competency frameworks Excellent facilitation, coaching and communication skills The confidence to work with clinical specialists and senior stakeholders without needing to be the clinical expert in the room Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to build credibility across different teams A proactive and solutions-focused approach, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving business Strong project-management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver work through to completion Experience using data, feedback and performance measures to evaluate learning and drive improvement Experience supporting organisational change, service transformation or the implementation of new systems and processes Confidence using learning management systems, digital learning tools and reporting platforms A relevant Learning and Development, education or training qualification would be beneficial but is not essential Professional registration with a healthcare body is a plus, but not required What we offer: Generous Leave : 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + 8 bank holidays Pension Matching : Up to 5% employer matching contributions Flexibility and Wellness : Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more Growth Opportunities : Collaborate across teams with support to grow your skills and impact Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave About Us Montu is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey. As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK.
